author: Flywheel

Assignees.description: Comma separated ist of user emails to assign ReaderTasks. If empty, gear will fail.

Baseline Operating Mode.description: Comma separated ist of Flywheel user emails to assign ReaderTasks. If empty & Operating Mode=Detection+ReaderTasks, gear will fail. e.g. bob@flywheel.io, mary@flywheel.io

Bounding Box Fill.description: Color to fill bounding box. Options: contrast, background

Entities to Find.description: List of entities the gear should look for. Current list shows all possible entities; remove any entity not needed.

Entity Frequency Threshold.description: Only applied on multi-frame files, frequency_threshold specifies the minimum number of times as a percentage (0 to 100) an entity must appear across frames to be included in all frames. Default=30. Does not impact single frame files.

Transformer Score Threshold.description: The minimum confidence score (0 to 100) required for an entity identified by the transformer to be considered PHI. Default=30

Use DICOM Metadata.description: If true, creates a regex recognizer from DICOM metadata to facilitate identifying PHI text in DICOM pixel data. Default=False

apikey_path_prefix.description: The instance specific AWS parameter gearbot path prefix

description: This gear utilizes Mircrosoft's open source Presidio SDK to scan images for potential Personal Identifiable Information (PII), report on PII findings, and redact PII contained within pixel data.

bbox_coords.description: Json containing the bounding box coordinates of a previous scanning run.

image_file.description: A dicom file or zipped dicom series.
